method: monotonic text alignment: for each fawazahmed0 hadith with text, best Jaccard over normalised Arabic word sets (diacritics/tatweel stripped, alif/ya/ta-marbuta folded, page/ms markers removed, words >= 3 letters) within +-700 units of its proportional position, kept if >= 0.5; then longest strictly increasing subsequence of unit indices. Units read with unit_start /^# ([0-9]+) /u and unit_stop /^(###|# \|)/u after #META#Header#End#, index = file order from 0.
